details.title: Moonglow
details.lead: Rod Stewart's sung line, played straight on the trumpet, an octave above where he sings it, in his key: concert D4 to G5 (written E4 to A5).
facts: Moonglow, as Rod Stewart sings it on the recording you sent
Rod's voice, read note by note and straightened
B♭ concert, C for the trumpet
The song as Rod sings it, with rests where Arturo Sandoval's trumpet takes the solo
